body: Profile hero zigzag root cause: mediaTop, mediaH and bandHeight in ChatProfileAvatarMorphView were each pixelRound()ed per frame, so media bottom = round(mediaTop)+round(mediaH) disagreed with band = round(bandHeight) by up to 1px and oscillated as p swept. Second cause: profileHeroScrollBand's GeometryReader minY fed pull/away back into the band height while the spring ran. Fix = interpolate continuously (round endpoints only) and gate pull/away on !heroMorphInFlight.
